what_work: What should we work on in {project}?
placeholder: Ask anything or give a task… (/ skill, @ agent, # MCP tool)
perm_ask_desc: Asks before every file write in the project folder, every command that is not read-only and every internet access (search, page download, package install).
perm_auto_desc: Writing, building, running, installing and internet use inside the project need no approval. Dangerous commands (deleting, killing processes, registry, git push --force…) and writing outside the project ask first.
perm_full_desc: Nothing is asked: dangerous commands and writes outside the project run without approval too. Only the protections in the note below apply in every mode.
confirm_remove_project: Remove the project and its chats from the list? Files on disk are not touched.
name: Name
pick_folder_hint: Pick the folder where project output is saved. If none, one is created under chat/projects/.
context_size_hint: Larger context uses more VRAM/RAM on local models. Applied when the model reloads.
theme_desc: Light, dark or follow the system
models_desc: Models used for chat and visual testing
active_model_desc: Switching to a local model unloads other local models
cloud_fallback_desc: When the selected model (local or cloud) cannot be reached, is down or overloaded, the fallback model answers only if this is on. Quota, key and request errors are reported to you.
context_compress_desc: Old messages are summarized before the context fills up
compress_threshold_desc: When the real context use reported by the provider reaches this share of the window, older steps are trimmed and summarized (default 80%).
context_local_desc: Read from the model (Ollama /api/show, LM Studio)
default_permission_desc: Approval behavior for agent commands and file changes
agent_limits_desc: Prevents endless loops and runaway resource use
security_note: Note: commands run directly on this computer; the command filter is not a sandbox, the approval mode is the real control. Blocked in every mode (full access too): system-breaking commands (formatting a disk, diskpart, bcdedit, deleting shadow copies, fork bombs), killing runtimes such as python/node BY NAME (it would close this app too), reading or writing your API keys (secrets.json) and the chat database, and a chat's own record folder (.session).
confirm_delete_provider: Delete this provider and its key?
cloud_providers_desc: Models of enabled providers with a key appear in the picker
add_language_desc: Enter code and English name; en.json is auto-translated
skills_desc: Invoked with / in chat. Markdown instructions are added to the system prompt.
agents_desc: Invoked with @ in chat. Defines the agent role.
import_url_ph: GitHub/https URL (…/SKILL.md), owner/repo, 'npx skills add owner/repo', 'hf skills add', 'gradio skills add'
err_missing_credentials: API key missing — add it in Settings > Providers
err_missing_account: Account ID missing — type it in the provider card or the image service card
err_forbidden: Not permitted — check key permissions or region (403)
err_terms: Provider terms not accepted — Settings > Test > Read & accept terms
err_payment: Insufficient credits (402) — add credits to your account
err_quota: Quota or credit limit reached — check your plan/balance or retry later
err_rate_limit: Too many requests (429) — wait a moment and retry
err_context_length: Context window exceeded — compress the chat or increase context size
err_no_tools: This model does not support tool calling — switched to text protocol
err_model_not_found: Model not found — check the name; for a local model download it (ollama pull), for a cloud model pick a current one from the list
err_not_found: Endpoint not found (404) — check the provider URL
err_bad_request: Request rejected (400) — unsupported parameter or invalid input
err_too_large: Request too large (413) — reduce attachments or compress the chat
err_timeout: Timed out — the provider did not respond in time
err_unavailable: Provider unreachable — is the server running and the URL correct?
err_overloaded: Provider overloaded or temporarily unavailable (503/529) — retry
err_degenerate: The model repeats one character instead of text (the local runtime or GPU backend may be broken)
err_degenerate_detail: The model keeps producing a repeated character instead of text. This usually means the local runtime or GPU backend is broken for this model: try another model, or turn the GPU option (e.g. Vulkan) off in Settings > Providers > Ollama.
ai_note_degenerate: The model's output turned into a repeated character; trying once more with a repeat penalty.
err_bad_gateway: Bad gateway (502) — the routed model is not responding
err_moderation: Content was blocked by the provider's safety policy
err_disabled: Provider disabled — enable it in Settings
err_empty: The model returned an empty response
err_request: Could not send the request to the server
unsaved_change: Unsaved change — press Save or Enter
terms_needed: This key is valid but the terms of use are not accepted yet.
ctx_no_stats: Details appear after the first reply
no_outputs: No files created in this chat yet
confirm_rollback: Files will be restored to snapshot {sha}. This is saved as a new snapshot and can be undone.
model_unavailable: This model is not currently available
available_models_desc: Enabled providers with a key; each loads independently
no_usable_providers: No usable provider — enable one in Providers
vision_unavailable: {m} is not installed/available — pick a vision model from the list
provider_not_usable: Enable the provider and save its key to see models
web_engines_desc: APIs with a key are used first. When there are none, or they find too little, the free ddgs library (Google, Yahoo, Bing, Yandex, Brave), Wikipedia/Wikidata and the built-in engines step in; as a last resort a background browser runs the same search.
brave_desc: Brave Search API key (free tier available)
tavily_desc: Search API built for AI agents
searxng_desc: Your own SearXNG instance URL (JSON output enabled)
web_policy: Results are merged across engines and off-topic ones are dropped. Pages that cannot be read are taken from an archived copy (Wayback Machine). Bot checks are never solved; that engine is rested for a while.
confirm_delete_folder: Folder {name} and everything in it will be permanently deleted.
chat_folder_pending: This chat has no folder yet
chat_folder_pending_desc: A chat/<chat-id>/ folder for this chat is created with your first message. Your attachments, downloads and everything the model makes appear there. To work in a project, pick one on the left.
empty_folder_drop: Empty folder — drag and drop files here
no_history: No snapshots yet (kept for project folders only)
welcome_sub: Your autonomous assistant that writes code, runs commands, tests and researches with local and cloud models. Give me a goal and I'll handle the rest.
compress_busy: Cannot compress while the chat is running; wait for it to finish
cap_tools_native_desc: The model calls tools via the provider's native function calling
cap_tools_text_desc: No native tool support; AI IQ 300 provides tools through its text protocol
cap_thinking_desc: Produces a reasoning trace before answering
no_vision_warning: The selected model has no vision support; attached images may be ignored. Pick a vision model.
compress_trim_desc: Older tool output was trimmed (not summarized)
model_msg_lms_missing: LM Studio CLI (lms) not found; the model will load on first request
err_name_exists: An item with this name already exists
err_compress_busy: Cannot compress while the chat is running
err_approval_stale: This approval is no longer valid
err_root_protected: The root folder cannot be changed
err_forbidden_command: This command is forbidden by the safety policy
err_no_terms: This provider has no terms to accept
err_folder_too_broad: The home folder or a drive root cannot be a project folder; pick a subfolder
err_invalid_item_name: Names may contain only lowercase letters, digits, - and _
err_core_agent: Core agents cannot be deleted (they can be edited)
err_path_escape: This path is outside the working folder
vision_model_no_vision: This model has no vision support; screenshot analysis will not work. Pick a model tagged "Vision".
err_no_model: No model selected — pick one under the message box or add a provider in Settings > Providers
add_chrome_desc: Agent that opens and visually tests pages in a browser
goal_desc: Works on its own with a to-do list until the goal is reached
plan_mode_desc: Plans first, then carries out the plan
drawing_desc: Draw a sketch and send it as an image
draw_hint: Click and drag to start drawing
mm_desc: Use cloud models together: automatic switch when a quota runs out, separate models for agents, and the model handing part of the work to another model.
mm_auto_switch: Switch automatically when a quota runs out
mm_auto_switch_desc: On quota, credit or repeated errors the task does not stop; it continues the same conversation on the most available pool model.
mm_prefer_fast_desc: When a pool model is picked, the measured first-answer time and failure rate count; when off, the pool order decides.
ms_desc: Each model's record measured on this computer: tasks, failure rate (including tasks that had to move to another model), first-token wait, turn time and prompt reading speed.
ms_empty: No measurements yet. They appear here after a few tasks.
mm_delegate_desc: The running model can hand a sub-task (review, draft, second opinion) to the most available pool model by quota, speed and context.
mm_local_note: Local models are never in the pool: several local models at once can freeze the computer. A local model may call cloud models, never another local model. The system works only while the pool has active cloud models.
mm_pool_desc: Cloud models that may be used and what they are good at. Selection weighs capability, remaining quota, rate limit and context.
mm_empty_pool: The pool is empty. Use Add to add a cloud model.
mm_agents_desc: Each agent can run on its own model; empty uses the model selected in the chat. When the assigned model runs out of quota the agent falls back to the main model.
quota_desc: Last 5 hours and last 7 days per provider; with a limit set, the provider is skipped once it is used up. Remaining allowances reported by the provider are shown too.
ai_note_server_ttl: {n} server(s) started in this task are still running; they stop automatically in {m} min (to stop them now: Context > Background tasks).
server_ttl_desc: Servers the agent started (start) and left running are stopped this many minutes after the task. 0 = never.
mm_local_ignored: Local models cannot be assigned; this agent runs on the main model.
rules_desc: Every chat in this project follows these rules (e.g. "use Tailwind", "PHP 8.2, no frameworks", "comments in English"). They live in AIIQ.md at the project root; when you say "remember this" in a chat, the model adds to it too.
rules_placeholder:
- Use Tailwind CSS for the UI
- Write code comments in English
- Database: SQLite
global_rules_desc: Lasting preferences added to every chat. For project-specific rules use Project rules in the project menu.
global_rules_hint: Saved when you leave the field.
preview_truncated: The diff is very long; only the first part is shown. The full change is in the file after approval.
preview_binary: Binary or very large file; the content cannot be shown.
model_profiles_desc: Override what the provider reports for the selected model. Auto keeps the provider's default; changes are saved at once.
prof_thinking_desc: Off: the model does not think, or its thinking is hidden (faster replies). On: asks for thinking (on Anthropic only in chats without tools).
prof_vision_desc: Whether the model can see images. Correct it here if the provider reports it wrongly.
prof_streaming_desc: Off: the reply arrives in one piece. For servers that have trouble streaming (Ollama and OpenAI-compatible providers).
prof_tools_desc: Native: the provider's function calling. Tags: the in-text tag protocol, for models whose function calls fail.
prof_temperature_desc: 0–2. Lower is more consistent, higher more creative.
prof_max_tokens_desc: Most tokens generated in one reply. Empty: provider default.
profile_save_failed: The profile could not be saved
effort_desc_api: Higher effort thinks more thoroughly; it takes longer and uses quota faster. Levels come from the model's API data.
effort_desc_prompt: This model's API offers no effort setting; the chosen level is passed to the model as an instruction.
voice_desc: Answers are read aloud with the voice you choose. Code blocks and links are not read.
voice_unsupported: This browser does not support speech synthesis.
voice_auto_desc: When a task finishes the answer is read aloud. You can also use the speaker under each answer.
voice_none: No installed voice for this language; add one in Windows Settings > Time & language > Speech.
voice_sample: Hello, I am AI IQ 300. I will read your answers with this voice.
team_tokens_hint: This member's model: context of its last turn and total tokens used (the provider's real counts)
mcp_desc: Connect Model Context Protocol servers (GitHub, PostgreSQL, file system, browser...). Their tools are offered to the model automatically.
mcp_empty: No MCP servers yet. Use Add with a command (stdio) or an address (HTTP).
mcp_secret_keep: Saved: {keys}. Leave empty to keep them; type to replace them.
mcp_secret_note: Environment variables and headers (tokens) are kept in the secret store, not in the settings file, and are never sent back to the UI.
mcp_save_failed: The MCP server could not be saved
mcp_safety: Tools marked read-only (green) run without asking; the others ask on every call unless Full access is on. Only add servers from sources you trust.
mcp_presets_desc: Add one with a click. Public ones work at once; sign-in ones show a Sign in button in the list, token ones open the form.
mcp_p_deepwiki: Reads the docs of GitHub repositories and answers questions about them (no key).
mcp_p_context7: Up-to-date library docs and code examples (no key).
mcp_p_everything: MCP test server: checks that npx and Node.js work.
mcp_cmd_note: The command must be an MCP server that keeps running (e.g. npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory); you may type the whole line into the command field. Install or login commands such as 'npm install', 'krea auth login' are not servers; for 'npx skills add owner/repo', 'hf skills add' or 'gradio skills add' the app offers to import the skills.
mcp_http_note: For hosted services enter their MCP URL (e.g. https://api.krea.ai/mcp). Services that need a sign-in get a Sign in button in the list; for an API key add the header Authorization=Bearer KEY.
mcp_signin_hint: The service's own page opens in a new tab; once you approve, the server connects by itself.
vs_menu_desc: Pro timeline editor: scenes, transitions, text, logo, music, effects, live AI edits
vs_open_failed: The project could not be opened
vs_drop: Drop files anywhere on the studio; they go to the media/ folder.
vs_no_media: No media in this chat's folder yet. Upload some, or ask the AI to download photos.
vs_empty: Add scenes from Media, or drop files here, to start.
vs_select_hint: Select an item on the timeline or the preview. Drag text and logos on the preview, resize them from the corner dot. Space: play/pause, Delete: remove, Ctrl+Z: undo.
vs_say_note: The voice-over is made with a natural voice at render time; the music ducks under it automatically.
vs_drag_hint: Drag it on the preview; X/Y can be percent (e.g. 70%) or left/center/right.
vs_music_note: Add your own music from Media. Drag the left edge to trim its start, drag the block to move where it starts.
vs_ai_placeholder: Tell the AI: "put the logo top right, add a price on scene 3, make the music upbeat"…
vs_ai_prompt:
[Video Studio] Project file: {project} (output: {output}). Request: {request}
Call the edit_video tool with ONLY the changes: {"base": "{project}", ...changes}. Examples: scene text {"scenes": {"3": {"caption": "..."}}}, logo {"logo": {"src": "images/logo.png", "position": "top_right"}}, music {"music": "upbeat"}, a new layer {"add_clips": [...]}. Do not rewrite the JSON. If a new picture is needed, use stock_photo / generate_image first. Report only what the edit_video result says.
vs_ai_sent: Sent to the chat; the AI's changes appear here when it updates the project.
make_video_desc: Describe it; AI finds the visuals and delivers a finished video with scenes, music and voice-over
make_video_prefix: Make a professional 15-second promo video with music and voice-over for:
make_image_desc: Photo-real images, illustrations or 3D from a description; keyed services first, free FLUX as backup
svc_blocked: The service blocked automated requests (bot check / rate limit)
svc_empty: The service works but returned nothing for this query
lm_menu_desc: AI-assisted logo for your brand: symbol, type style, colors, transparent PNG
lm_ai_failed: The AI could not suggest directions
lm_cutout_failed: The background could not be removed
lm_note: Symbols come from the image services (keyed ones first, free FLUX last) with the background removed. The PNG is transparent and trimmed; use it as a logo layer in the studio.
vl_auto_note: With no voice chosen, the default of Settings > Voices is used (else the best local voice, else an online one).
vl_tts_menu_desc: Turn text into MP3 with 400+ free natural voices; search, listen, set the speed
vl_tts_desc: Type the text, pick a voice from the library and listen; download the MP3 or save it to the chat folder.
vl_stt_menu_desc: Transcript and SRT subtitles from audio or video, offline
vl_stt_desc: Pick an audio/video file or record from the microphone; the speech is transcribed on this computer (offline) and can be downloaded as TXT and SRT subtitles.
vs_logo_hint: Pick a logo, sticker or photo and press '+ Layer'; drag it on the preview and resize from the corner. For transparent PNG logos: Create > Logo maker.
vs_voiceover_desc: Reads the text with the voice you pick and adds it as an audio clip at the playhead.
vs_voice_failed: The voice-over could not be made
vs_animate_note: At render time the photo becomes a clip that really moves (free image-to-video AI, ~1 min per photo, a daily free quota; cached). Without quota it keeps the Ken Burns move.
vs_animate_failed: Some photos could not be animated (quota / busy); they kept Ken Burns:
vs_rendering_animate: Photos are being animated with AI; about a minute per photo.
vs_lib_failed: The music library could not be reached
vs_lib_note: Openverse (Jamendo, Freesound…) — licences that allow commercial use. The credit is written to music/CREDITS.txt; mention it in your video.
vs_ai_need_agent: This needs new media; the agent takes over.
vs_no_chat: Open the studio from a chat to send the AI a request.
voice_on_hint: Voice commands on: speak; say "send", "stop", "approve", "deny", "new chat", "read", "quiet".
voice_busy: A task is running; say "stop" first
ai_note_no_native: Native tool calling not supported; switched to the text protocol: {e}
ai_note_leak: Unparsed tool syntax was hidden; the model was asked to retry the call.
ai_note_code_not_run: A command was written but not executed; redoing it with the real tools.
ai_note_open_todos: The model wrote its answer while {n} planned items are still open; it is asked to finish them.
ai_note_unresolved: The last command failed but the model was finishing; it is asked to fix it first.
ai_note_unresolved_final: ⚠️ The last command still fails: the related step in this answer may not be done.
ai_note_code_run: The model wrote the command as a code block instead of running it; it is being run for real now.
ai_note_not_delivered: The answer presents a file that is not on disk ({files}); the model is asked to really create it.
ai_note_not_delivered_final: ⚠️ This file was not created and is not on disk: {files}. If the answer below says it is ready, that is not true.
ai_note_cli_calls: The model wrote a tool call as plain text ({names}); it was recognized and is being run for real.
ai_budget_note: The step limit was reached ({n} steps) before the task finished. Type "continue" to resume where it stopped; the limit can be raised in Settings > Agent.
ai_note_no_action: ⚠️ No tool ran in this turn: no file was changed and no command was run. The reply below is only the model's claim; repeat your request or pick another model to get it done.
drop_sub: Images, documents, code, videos or folders — added to the chat; folders keep their structure in the working folder.
draw_hand: Pan (hand) · or hold Space and drag
draw_edit_hint: Click to draw or add text on it
web_shot_desc: Captures a page and shows it in the chat
web_shot_prefix: Take a screenshot of this page:
voice_default_hint: The active language's female neural voice; the browser voice when offline
voice_neural_offline: Natural voices are unreachable (no internet or edge-tts not installed); browser voices are used.
voice_privacy: Natural voices are free and need no key; the text to read is sent to Microsoft's read-aloud service to be spoken. Browser voices work offline and the text never leaves the computer.
voice_per_lang: Saved for {lang} only; other languages use their own voice.
err_network: Network connection lost — check your connection and retry
err_unknown_kind: This provider type is not supported — check the provider settings
cf_account_hint: Shown on the Workers AI page of the Cloudflare dashboard. Use an API token with Workers AI permission as the API key.
err_plan_required: This model needs a paid plan — upgrade your plan or pick another model
ai_note_lang: Fixing words written in another language.
ai_note_lang_done: Words in another language were translated (only the reply was fixed, without a second thinking pass).
ai_note_lang_kept: The reply language could not be fixed; the reply is kept as it was.
google_search_desc: Google Programmable Search (Custom Search JSON API) key; 100 queries a day free
google_cx_desc: Create an engine with "Search the entire web" on at programmablesearchengine.google.com
yandex_folder_desc: The folder ID in the Yandex Cloud console (starts with b1g…)
bing_search_desc: Bing Web Search API v7 (Azure). Microsoft stopped selling it in 2025; existing keys keep working
maps_services_desc: Place search (the places tool): Google or Yandex when a key is set (ratings, review counts, price level); free OpenStreetMap otherwise.
google_maps_desc: Google Places API (New) key for place search. "Places API (New)" must be enabled for the project in Google Cloud console, otherwise it answers 403 PERMISSION_DENIED.
osm_desc: Nominatim + Overpass: free, no key; address, phone, website, opening hours
browser_agent_desc: The model navigating a real browser window like a person: opening pages, clicking, filling forms (browser_ tools)
browser_dismiss_desc: Detects modals on sites (newsletter, campaign, gender picker, app ads...) and closes them with their close button or Escape; on cookie banners it always picks the most private choice (Reject all). Windows with a password or card field are left alone.
browser_visible_desc: On: you can see the browser window too (needed when you must sign in or solve a CAPTCHA; a hidden browser opens a window by itself when that happens). Off: runs hidden in the background
browser_channel_desc: Which browser to open (falls back to the app's own Chromium if it is not installed)
browser_channel_fast_hint: Opens pages in the background without images, video or fonts: reading, clicking and filling forms is much faster. The window is always hidden; switch to a normal browser when you need to sign in.
browser_profile_desc: Sign-ins you make in the browser window (cookies) are kept here and reused in later tasks; they never leave this computer.
browser_reset_done: The browser profile was deleted; every sign-in was forgotten.
browser_agent_note: The browser agent never types passwords or card details itself; on a real site it hands the window to you for sign-in and payment steps (browser_handoff). Irreversible steps like send/delete/buy ask for your approval first.
changes_partial: The folder is very large; the comparison is partial.
change_by_tool_hint: Changed by the file tools (write, edit, document)
change_by_command_hint: Changed by a command, script, formatter or package manager
agents_pick_desc: Search agents and add one to the message (@)
ai_interrupted: The task was interrupted (the app or computer stopped). The completed steps are kept; type "continue" to resume where it stopped.
ai_note_resume: Continuing from the record of the interrupted task ({n} steps already done).
ai_note_truncated: The model's output was cut off while writing {name}; asking it to write the content in parts.
confirm_archive_chats: All chats of this project will be archived. Files are not deleted.
confirm_delete_message: This message will be removed from the chat permanently and no longer sent to the model.
ddg_desc: Keyless DuckDuckGo search page (queued and spaced-out queries).
ddgs_desc: Free ddgs library: Google, Yahoo, Bing, Yandex and Brave results without a key.
first_token_timeout_desc: The longest wait for a cloud model to read a long prompt and send its first token (default 300 s: this is the '300-second watchdog').
local_stream_timeout_desc: How long a silent Ollama / LM Studio request may wait (∞ = no limit; long prompts take minutes on CPU).
model_connection_desc: A stalled stream is retried after these times; the steps done so far are kept and the task never starts over.
pdf_desc: Designed PDF (every language, formulas, clickable links)
provider_retries_desc: How often a stalled or busy request is retried before the task stops (waits grow from 5 s to 2 min).
skills_pick_desc: Search skills and add one to the message (/)
stream_timeout_desc: If a cloud model stays silent this long in the middle of an answer (also while writing a file or command), the request is retried. The silence watchdogs below usually decide earlier.
wiki_desc: Wikipedia and Wikidata reference pages (always added).
err_run_busy: This chat is still working; wait for it or stop it.
concurrency_limit_desc: Most requests sent to this provider at once (titles, summaries, team members, a second chat included). Extra ones wait in line instead of failing; after a "busy" or 429 answer requests go one at a time for 5 minutes. Ollama Cloud free: 1, Pro: 3. Empty = 3.
rpm_limit_desc: How many requests the provider accepts per minute (NVIDIA free: 40). The app paces itself to it, so no 429 errors. Empty = no limit.
think_on_hint: The model reasons before answering (supported by its API). Click to turn off.
think_off_hint: Thinking off: faster, fewer tokens. Click to turn on.
parallel_tools_desc: Independent research, page and file reading calls of one step run at the same time (single model and team). Writes to different files run in parallel too; calls touching the same file (writing a file and making a document from it) and calls to the same MCP server run one after another. Results are added to the context in order.
unlimited_iterations_desc: The task runs without a step cap until it finishes, you stop it or it repeats itself.
unlimited_debug_desc: Errors never stop the task: the model sees each one and fixes it. When the very same error keeps coming back, it is made to research it and take another route (more patience with this on).
changes_edits_hint: How many tool edits this task made to the file; +/− is the net change against the start of the task.
video_broken: This video could not be opened: the file is broken or incomplete.
video_unsupported: This video cannot play in the browser (broken file or unsupported format/codec).
video_no_picture: This file has no picture (audio only or an empty file).
video_error_hint: Ask the model to produce it again as an H.264/AAC MP4, or download it and open it in another player.
ai_note_promise: The model only announced the work; it was asked to really do it with tools.
ai_note_no_visual: The requested chart/image is not in the document; the model was asked to really create and add it.
prep_first: Request sent (~{tok} tokens) · the model is reading the prompt, waiting for the first token
prep_tool_stream: The model is writing a tool call
prep_tool_silent: The model is writing a tool call (the provider sends it in one piece when done)
prep_writing: The model is writing its answer
steer_sent: Message passed to the running task; it keeps going with it.
ai_note_salvaged: The connection dropped while {path} was being written; the {n} characters already written were saved and the model continues from there.
ai_note_stream_tags: This provider sends a tool call only when it is complete; switched to the text protocol so files stream and nothing is lost if the connection drops.
fallback_model_desc: Used when the selected model cannot answer (quota, outage).
rt_ollama_desc: Environment variables of the Ollama server, saved where Ollama itself reads them (Windows: user environment variables, same as setx). Auto = the variable is removed and Ollama uses its default. Changes apply after Ollama restarts.
rt_lms_desc: Load options sent to LM Studio every time a model loads (a model loads when you pick it in the model picker). Auto = LM Studio decides.
rt_ollama_not_installed: Ollama was not found on this computer.
rt_ollama_start_timeout: Ollama did not answer within 30 seconds.
rt_pending: {n} setting(s) saved; restart Ollama to apply them.
rt_vram_hint: Share of the loaded model kept in graphics memory. GPU 0% = the model runs on the CPU.
rt_vulkan_desc: OLLAMA_VULKAN. GPU acceleration on cards without CUDA/ROCm support (e.g. older AMD RX, Intel). Turn it off if it causes problems.
rt_vk_f16_desc: GGML_VK_DISABLE_F16. Prevents garbled output or crashes on older cards with weak half-precision support (e.g. RX 580).
rt_flash_desc: Less memory, usually faster. Auto: on when the hardware supports it.
rt_kv_desc: OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE. Full (f16) is best quality; Half (q8_0) about half the memory with very little loss; Low (q4_0) a quarter of the memory with some loss. Applies to all models.
rt_kv_needs_fa: KV cache quantization only works with flash attention on.
rt_parallel_desc: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL. How many requests one model handles at the same time. Default 1. Every parallel slot reserves its own context memory: 4 slots means 4x the RAM for context. For a single user, 1 is the fastest and safest value.
rt_max_loaded_desc: OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS. How many models may stay in memory at the same time.
rt_gpu_offload_desc: How much of the model goes to the graphics card (lms load --gpu).
rt_kv_gpu_desc: Keep the context cache in graphics memory or in RAM.
rt_batch_desc: Input tokens processed per step. Larger reads prompts faster and uses more memory.
rt_ttl_desc: A model unused for this many seconds is unloaded (lms load --ttl).
rt_lms_missing: GPU offload and idle time need the lms command (LM Studio > Developer > install CLI).
streaming_always_desc: This API is always used streaming; it cannot be switched off.
ai_note_ctx_grown: The context window ({old}) could not hold the instructions and tools; it was raised to {new} for this model (change it in the model picker or Settings > Context).
prep_tool_silent_local: The local model is writing a tool call; Ollama sends it when complete · {s} s
prep_tool_silent_switch: The provider sends the tool call only when complete · no data for {s} s · switching to streaming in {left} s
prep_tool_silent_wait: The model is writing a tool call (the provider sends it when complete) · no data for {s} s
prep_stalled: No data from the provider for {s} s (it may be busy) · timeout and retry in {left} s (Settings > Security)
prep_after_think: The model finished thinking; waiting for the first part of its answer / tool call · no data for {s} s
prep_stalled_local: The local model is writing · no new data for {s} s
ai_note_ctx_grown_conv: The task no longer fit the context window ({old}) and there was nothing left to compress; it was raised to {new} for this model so nothing is cut off (change it in the model picker or Settings > Context).
rt_parallel_warn: {n} parallel slots: context memory grows {n}x. With a large model and too little RAM the computer can freeze or blue-screen. The app caps the window to the RAM and unloads the model when RAM runs low, but 1 is recommended.
rt_parallel_confirm:
Set parallel requests to {n}?

Every slot reserves its own context memory: {n}x the RAM for context. With a large local model (e.g. 30B-35B) and little RAM the computer can freeze or blue-screen.

For a single user, 1 is recommended.
ai_ram_guard: Free RAM fell to {free} GB of {total} GB: {model} was unloaded to keep the computer responsive.
ai_ram_guard_busy: Free RAM fell to {free} GB of {total} GB: the running model {model} was unloaded so the computer does not crash (its task stops). Use a smaller model, a cloud model or a smaller context window.
ai_err_no_ram: {model} needs about {need} GB of RAM for its weights alone, but only {free} GB is free (of {total} GB, after a safety reserve). It was not loaded, to protect the computer. Close other programs, or pick a smaller local model or a cloud model. The safety reserve and "Warn only": Settings > Providers > local provider > Local model memory.
ai_note_parallel_ram: Ollama keeps {parallel} parallel slots, each with its own context memory: the window was limited to {ctx} so the computer does not run out of RAM. Set parallel requests to 1 (Settings > Providers > Ollama) for a larger window.
diffs_binary: Binary file (image, media...): no line diff. Use the button on the right to open it.
diffs_no_diff: No line diff was recorded for this operation.
ai_note_loop: The model began repeating the same text; the repeats were removed and its answer was ended there.
voice_pick_hint: Every voice of this language: ▶ plays the first sentence in that voice; pick the one you like and the audio is made again with it.
step_retry_stalled: Stream stopped, continuing where it left off
step_retry_looping: Repetition removed, continuing where it left off
ai_note_loop_retry: The model began repeating itself; the repeats were removed and it continues from its last sound point (with a repeat penalty).
ai_note_overthink: The model reasoned for a very long time without acting; its plan so far was kept and it is asked to act on it now.
err_stalled: The provider stopped in the middle of a file; the written part was saved and the model continues from there.
image_services_desc: The generate_image tool: realistic photos, 3D looks and illustrations from a description. Services with a key are tried in order; one that is out of quota or rate limited is skipped, and when all are unavailable the free Pollinations makes the picture.
stock_services_desc: Keyed and switched-on services are searched first (Pexels, Pixabay, Unsplash). One that is out of quota or rate limited is skipped; when none is usable, the free Openverse and Wikimedia Commons photos are used.
gemini_img_desc: Gemini image model (gemini-2.5-flash-image). It uses the same key as the Gemini provider.
cloudflare_img_desc: FLUX.1 schnell on Cloudflare Workers AI. Needs a key and the account id; the free tier has a daily limit.
cloudflare_account_desc: the 32-character account id from the Cloudflare dashboard
hf_img_desc: FLUX.1 schnell through Hugging Face inference providers.
together_img_desc: FLUX.1 schnell on Together AI (paid or free tier).
stability_img_desc: Stability AI Stable Image Core (paid credits).
pexels_desc: Pexels photos (free API key; limits of 200 requests an hour and 20,000 a month).
pixabay_desc: Pixabay photos (free API key; a limit of 100 requests a minute).
unsplash_desc: Unsplash photos (Access Key; the demo tier allows 50 requests an hour).
pollinations_desc: Free FLUX model, works without a key; the free tier puts a small pollinations.ai logo in a corner. With the token of a free account from auth.pollinations.ai, pictures come logo-free.
confirm_delete_chats: The selected chats are deleted permanently with their messages, summaries, records and the files of their working folders. This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_messages: The selected messages and the history made from them (their lines in the chat record, a summary that contains them, the saved progress of an interrupted task) are deleted permanently; the model never sees them again. Files in the working folder are kept. This cannot be undone.
split_write_desc: Off (recommended): the model writes every file in one call, however large. Pick a number and files longer than that many characters are written in parts. One exception applies by itself: when a provider's per-request time limit is measured (e.g. NVIDIA 300 s), files on that provider are written in parts that fit it. A file is saved to disk live while it streams; if the stream breaks, the written part stays and the file is finished from there - a restart is never appended to it.
ai_note_truncated_kept: The model's output limit cut {path} at {n} characters; that part was saved and the model completes the file from there.
prompt_mode_desc: The rules, capability index and tool definitions sent at the start of every task. Automatic: the lean prompt (about half the tokens) for local models, small windows and models measured as slow readers, the full prompt for the others. With the lean prompt the model knows its abilities from a short index and opens what it needs itself.
guard_card_desc: When free memory runs low, in this order: the app's own caches are released, unused models are unloaded, then the context window of the model in use is made smaller. The model in use is not closed; the chat, its summary and the task's progress live in the app, so nothing is lost.
guard_enabled_desc: When off, only the check before loading remains (a model that does not fit is not loaded).
guard_emergency: Unload the model in an emergency
guard_emergency_desc: Off (recommended): the model is never closed. On: when the window is already at its smallest and memory is still critical, the model in use is unloaded too so the computer does not crash; the task keeps its record and "continue" resumes it.
guard_no_vram_sub: no dedicated GPU memory found: models run on the CPU
guard_model_fits: {model}: weights {need} GB, {free} GB available after the reserve - fits, largest window ~{ctx} tokens.
guard_model_short: {model}: weights {need} GB, but only {free} GB is available after the reserve - it is not loaded. Close programs, lower the reserve below, or choose "Warn only".
guard_load_check: A model that does not fit
guard_load_check_desc: Block (recommended): a local model whose weights do not fit in the free memory is not loaded - loading it anyway can freeze the computer or cause a blue screen. Warn only: it is loaded with a warning and a 4K window (for tests, at your own risk).
guard_warn_confirm: With "Warn only", a model larger than the free memory is loaded anyway. The computer may slow down a lot, freeze or show a blue screen. Continue?
guard_reserve_desc: Memory always left to Windows, the browser and this app before a model is loaded. Automatic is a tenth of the RAM (1.5-4 GB, here {auto} GB). A smaller reserve lets a slightly larger model load; below 1 GB the computer may become unresponsive.
ai_warn_no_ram: {model} needs about {need} GB of RAM for its weights, but only {free} GB is free (of {total} GB, after the reserve). It is loaded anyway because the memory guard is set to warn only: the computer may slow down a lot or freeze. The window is kept at 4K.
ai_guard_app: Free {what} is low ({free} GB of {total} GB): the app released {freed} MB of its own caches.
ai_guard_idle: Free {what} is low ({free} GB of {total} GB): the unused model {model} was unloaded. The model you use stays loaded.
ai_guard_shrunk: Free {what} is critically low ({free} GB of {total} GB): the context window of {model} was reduced from {old} to {new}. The model stays loaded and no chat memory was lost.
ai_guard_floor: Free {what} is critically low ({free} GB of {total} GB) and the window of {model} is already at its smallest. Close other programs.
ai_guard_unloaded: Free {what} is critically low ({free} GB of {total} GB): {model} was unloaded (emergency unload is on). The chat and the task's progress are kept; type "continue" to resume.
ai_note_ram_shrunk: Free memory ran critically low: the context window of this model was reduced from {old} to {new} to give memory back. The model stays loaded and the task continues; nothing of the chat is lost.
ai_note_ram_floor: Free memory is critically low and the context window is already at its smallest ({ctx}). Close other programs; the task continues.
ai_note_no_edit: The request was to change a file, but no file was changed; the model is asked to edit it.
vs_motion_prompt_ph: steam rising, people chatting, camera push in
err_bad_document: The document could not be read or its format is not supported
err_browser_busy: The browser is busy with another task; try again shortly
err_cutout: The background could not be removed; try another image
err_invalid_mcp: Invalid MCP server settings (command or address missing)
err_logo_icons: The symbol could not be generated; image services may be busy, try again
err_logo_suggest: The model could not suggest logos; try another model
err_music_download: The music could not be downloaded
err_music_library: The music library could not be reached; try again shortly
err_not_local: This can only be done on the local computer
err_not_ollama: This only works with Ollama models
err_render_failed: The video could not be rendered
err_rules_too_long: The rules text is too long
err_rules_write_failed: The rules could not be saved
err_stt_failed: The audio could not be transcribed
err_studio_ai: The model cannot answer now (busy, out of quota or offline); pick another model
err_studio_ai_format: The model did not return a valid edit; phrase the request more clearly or try another model
err_timeline: The edit could not be applied to the project
err_video_output_is_source: The output file cannot be the source video; choose another name
make_aiclip: AI clip: text / image to video
make_aiclip_desc: Describe it; a real moving video clip is made (Settings > Web > AI video: paid services, then free Wan 2.2)
make_aiclip_prefix: Generate a real moving AI video clip of this scene (generate_video):
video_engines_desc: Real video from images and text: Wan 2.2 and AnimateLCM-SVD on Hugging Face's free GPUs. Nothing to install or pay; generate_video, animate_image and the studio's "Animate with AI" try them in order. A free Hugging Face key (Image generation > Hugging Face) raises the daily quota.
ve_kind_wan: image to video · text to video
ve_sleeping: sleeping: wakes on the first call
ve_token_on: Hugging Face key saved: your own daily quota is used.
ve_token_off: No key: the shared free quota is used (may queue when busy).
mcp_p_thinking: Step-by-step thinking tool for hard problems (no key).
mcp_p_fetch: Reads web pages as Markdown (official, via uvx).
fb_switched: {from} could not answer; the task continues on {to} (the steps done so far are kept).
retry_wait: Retried after {s} s (#{n}); what was written is kept.
err_memory: Free memory is critically low; the task continues in a smaller window.
te_edit: The file could not be edited: the text to replace was not found or occurs in several places; the model retries with the file's real text.
te_missing: File or folder not found; the right path is shown when there is one.
te_program: A program it needs is not installed or not on PATH; an install command or another route is suggested.
te_port: The port is used by another program; a free port is used.
te_repeat: The same call was repeated with nothing changed; the model uses the earlier result.
te_placeholder: The document had placeholders instead of real text; the model writes the real content.
te_binary: This is a binary file format (.db, .jpg, .png…) and cannot be written as text. The model produces it for real with a command or tool.
te_args: The tool got incomplete arguments; the model adds the missing ones and calls it again.
te_download: The download failed (server error or no access).
te_blocked: This action is not allowed now or was stopped.
te_command: The command failed; the model reads the error and fixes it.
err_looping: The model began repeating the same block while writing a file; the repeats were removed, the written part kept, and the model continues properly.
ai_note_not_verified: The request asked to run and test it, but nothing was run or checked yet; the model is asked to do it now.
ai_note_code_not_written: The code was printed in the answer but no file was written; the model is asked to write the files.
err_offline: This computer lost its internet connection. The task is paused; once the connection is back it continues by itself on the same model, where it stopped (everything written and done is kept, the model is not switched). You can stop the task if you like.
ai_no_final: The model stopped without writing a final answer. Done in this task: {files}.{err} Write "continue" to let it go on.
ctx_peak: Highest in the last task: {n} (after a task its tool output is not sent with the next message, so the current value is lower)
ai_note_thinking_kept: The request broke off after the model had reasoned; its reasoning ({n} characters) was kept and the model continues from it instead of thinking everything through again.
prep_target_pending: file name not sent yet (the model is writing the content first)
steps_export_md: Download the steps as a .md file
step_retry_offline: No internet — waiting for the connection
cd_offline: continues where it stopped once back online
retry_until_online: Waited {s} s without internet; continued where it stopped once the connection was back.
retry_until_online_wait: Waiting for the connection to come back (no time limit; you can stop the task).
net_down: Internet connection lost — running tasks are paused and continue where they stopped once it is back
net_up_after: Internet connection is back (it was down for {s} s)
ai_note_back_online: The internet connection came back after {s} s; the task continues on the same model where it stopped.
probe_alive: the provider answered in {s} s — if the stream was lost it continues where it stopped
probe_slow: the provider is slow — the model is still working, waiting
video_services_desc: generate_video, animate_image, "Image to video" in the (+) menu and "Animate with AI" in the studio use these services in order: paid services with a key first, then the free Hugging Face GPUs. Only one runs at a time; the next is tried only if the one before fails (no race). A service you switch off is never used.
veo_desc: Google Veo 3 / 3.1 (the Gemini API key, same as Providers > Gemini). High-quality 4-8 s clips with sound; paid (needs a Gemini account with billing).
fal_desc: fal.ai: Wan 2.2, Kling 2.1, Hailuo 02, Seedance, Veo 3 Fast - priced per second, fast queue.
replicate_desc: Replicate: Wan 2.2 i2v, Kling, Hailuo, Seedance, Veo - priced per run.
runway_desc: Runway Gen-4 Turbo: 5 / 10 s cinematic clips, with credits.
ve_free_desc: Free Wan 2.2 (Hugging Face ZeroGPU). Shared quota without a key; a free Hugging Face key raises the daily quota. At most 5 s.
ve_free_svd_desc: Free backup AnimateLCM-SVD (Hugging Face). Image to video only; ignores the prompt.
media_model_desc: only models that make this kind of output are listed; without a choice the default is used: {d}
video_real_test_free: Makes a 2-4 s clip from a small picture (may take 1-2 min).
video_real_test_paid: Makes a real clip; the provider charges for it. The "Test" button is a free key check.
img2video_desc: Pick a photo; it becomes a real AI clip where things move (Settings > Web > AI video, in order)
img2video_prefix: Turn the attached photo {name} into a real moving video clip with animate_image. Motion:
err_model_retired: The provider retired this model (no longer offered to new users) — the app moved to the suggested new model by itself and removed the old one from the list
err_no_memory: Not enough free memory (RAM / VRAM) on this computer for this model — pick a smaller model or a smaller context
mcp_mine_desc: MCP servers you added yourself: switch them on or off, edit, restart or remove them.
mcp_mine_empty: No server of your own yet — add one with Add at the top right.
vs_subtitles_note: The voice-over's sentences are written on the video with their real timings; a .srt is saved next to it.
vl_preset_none_desc: No processing, only a peak limit
vl_preset_podcast_desc: Warm lows, clear mids, de-esser, -16 LUFS
vl_local_hint: Runs on this computer, no internet needed
vl_piper_hint: Fast on any CPU; 50+ languages incl. Turkish
vl_cbx_hint: Most natural and expressive; your own voice; slow
vp_default_desc: The voice used for each language: spoken replies, text to speech and video voice-overs. If none is chosen, the best local voice is used.
vp_lang_desc: The language whose default voice you set
vp_tone_desc: Applied to every voice-over: speed, pitch (semitones), emotion and the studio finish (EQ, compression, loudness standard).
vp_pause_desc: Doubled at the end of a paragraph
vp_room_desc: A small room's light reflections; makes a dry voice sound more natural
vp_quality_desc: Fast: Piper/Kokoro. Best quality: Chatterbox when installed (slow on a CPU).
vp_engines_desc: Engines never run at the same time: if the chosen voice fails, the next engine's voice of the same language and gender is used. Engines switched off are never used.
vp_engine_piper: Local, fast, 50+ languages (Turkish: dfki, fahrettin, fettah, Eren)
vp_engine_kokoro: Local, very natural English and 5 more languages
vp_engine_chatterbox: Local, the most natural and expressive, 23 languages, your own voice
vp_engine_edge: Microsoft online voices: the fallback while online
vp_cbx_desc: The most natural and expressive local voice (23 languages incl. Turkish) and voice-overs in your own voice. It uses PyTorch, so it is installed into its own environment (~4 GB, once); on a CPU each sentence takes a few seconds.
vp_cbx_remove_desc: Deletes the environment and model files (your own voice clips stay)
vp_remove_q: Delete {name} from this computer? It can be downloaded again.
vp_installed_desc: In data/tts; a deleted voice downloads again when needed.
vp_none_installed: No local voice yet: download one from the list above.
vp_own_desc: Upload or record 5–30 seconds of clear speech; Chatterbox reads with its timbre. Female/male is detected from its pitch.
vp_own_consent: This recording is my own voice or I have the owner's permission. I will not use it to imitate someone without consent.
hint_high_demand: The model is very busy right now (a temporary spike). The app tries again shortly; if it goes on, pick another model.
hint_rate_minute: The per-minute request limit was hit. The app continues by itself when the limit opens again.
hint_quota_daily: The daily / free quota is used up. This model is skipped until it resets; use another model or a paid plan.
hint_gpu_quota: The free GPU quota is used up for now. A free Hugging Face token in Settings > Providers > Hugging Face gives you your own daily quota.
hint_payment: The account balance is too low or payment is required.
hint_model_missing: This model is not available for this key or not supported; the app tries another model of the service.
hint_model_retired: The provider retired this model; the app moves to the suggested successor.
hint_timeout: The provider did not answer in time; it is tried again.
hint_safety: The request hit the provider's content rules; change the text and try again.
hint_auth: The API key is invalid or lacks permission; check it in Settings > Providers.
voice_tone_apply: Make it again with these settings
img2video_say: Make a real moving AI video clip from the picture {path} (generate_video, image="{path}"):
tpl_creator_say: [Template Creator: first explain briefly how templates work, ask me for a reference file; look at it and save the new template (for {kind}) with doc_template action=create]
tpl_creator_text: to create a new template. First explain how templates work and how they are used. Then ask me to upload a reference file and, if needed, ask me how and when the template should be used.
img2video_pick_title: Choose the picture to turn into a video
img2video_pick_desc: Pictures in the chat's working folder and the ones attached to the message; you can also upload a new one.
img2video_upload: Upload a picture from the computer
img2video_none: No pictures in this chat's folder; upload one above.
mode_ph_make_image: What kind of image? (subject, style, colours, aspect ratio…)
mode_ph_make_video: A promo video for what? (subject, length, music, voice-over…)
mode_ph_make_aiclip: What should move in the clip?
mode_ph_img2video: What should move in the picture? (e.g. the cat runs, the camera moves in)
mode_ph_docx: What should the Word document contain?
mode_ph_xlsx: Which data should the sheet hold?
mode_ph_pptx: What is the deck about, how many slides?
prep_think_stalled: The reasoning stream stopped mid-sentence · no data for {s} s · checking the connection; if it dropped, it continues with the reasoning kept
speed_avg: Average output speed of the task
mcp_p_sequential-thinking: Step-by-step thinking tool for hard problems (no key).
mcp_p_microsoft-learn: Search and read the official Microsoft / Azure / .NET docs (no key).
mcp_p_huggingface: Search Hugging Face models, datasets, Spaces and papers.
mcp_p_github: Repositories, issues, PRs and code: GitHub's official server (needs a personal access token).
mcp_p_sentry: Reads Sentry errors and issues (Sentry sign-in).
mcp_p_git: Log, diff and commit in local git repositories (official, via uvx).
mcp_p_playwright: Drives a browser through the page structure: clicks, forms, screenshots (npx).
mcp_p_notion: Notion pages and databases: search, read, write (Notion sign-in).
mcp_p_time: Current time and time-zone conversion (official, via uvx).
mcp_find_desc: Searches the official MCP registry, npm and GitHub. Ones that need no key are added with a click; the others open the form.
mcp_tool_desc: Pick a tool of a connected MCP server; the model calls it
mcp_say: Do this by calling the MCP tool {name} with the mcp tool:
mode_ph_mcp: What should the tool do? (leave empty and the model calls it with fitting arguments)
mcp_pick_none: No MCP server is running. Add one in Settings > MCP.
search_read_tip: The model read this source's page
mcp_args_hint: Fill in the tool's arguments; the model fills the empty ones from your message.
command_timeout_desc: The longest a command may run; it is stopped after that. A command with no output for 120 s, or one that starts listening on a port (a server started from a script), moves to the background so the task is not blocked; from then on this limit no longer applies to it, it runs until stop or the server time below.
allowed_origins_desc: Only pages opened from these addresses can use the app's local API (so another website cannot send commands through your browser). Edited in settings.json.
watchdogs_desc: Act when a cloud stream goes silent (seconds). The timeouts above are the upper limit; these decide earlier and smarter. Nothing written is lost: a cut stream continues where it stopped. Local models (Ollama, LM Studio) are not affected.
probe_after_desc: After this much silence a small test request goes to the provider: it tells whether the provider is up or only this stream was lost.
probe_first_desc: The same check before the first token; longer, because the provider may still be reading a long prompt.
probe_cut_desc: If the test request is answered at once while this stream stays silent, the work continues where it stopped after this time (longer for a slow stream's own pace).
stall_floor_desc: When a file that was arriving piece by piece suddenly stops, the limit is 10 x the stream's longest gap, but never below this.
midcall_stall_desc: If the stream stops this long while a file or command is being written, the written part is saved and the model continues from there.
silent_tool_limit_desc: If a provider that sends a tool call only when it is complete (EVREN, NIM) stays silent this long, the next steps switch to the live-streamed text format; the call is not cut.
conn_intro: Connect services in one click. Each connection sets up its own MCP server automatically, so models and agents can use those tools right away. Keys are stored only on this computer, in the secret key store.
conn_footer: Sending, deleting, merging and sharing actions ask for your approval before the model performs them (per your Security settings).
conn_disconnect_q: Remove the {name} connection and the MCP servers it set up? Imported project files are not deleted.
conn_github_desc: Import your repositories as projects and pull updates in one click; the GitHub MCP (issues, PRs, branches, code search) is set up automatically.
conn_github_waiting: Approve the GitHub sign-in in the browser window that opened…
conn_github_how: Uses the GitHub CLI or Git Credential Manager sign-in on this computer; otherwise GitHub's sign-in page opens.
conn_github_manual_desc: On the page that opened the scopes are preselected: click 'Generate token', copy it and paste it here.
conn_git_missing: Importing needs Git: winget install --id Git.Git -e
conn_repo_cloning: Cloning the repository (large ones can take a few minutes)…
conn_google_desc: Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Chat and Contacts: one sign-in lets the models work in your Google account (Google's regular APIs).
conn_browser_waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in in the browser…
conn_google_step1: Create a project in Google Cloud:
conn_google_step2: Enable the APIs and MCP services of the products you will use (e.g. gmail.googleapis.com and gmailmcp.googleapis.com; see the guide).
conn_google_step3: Create an OAuth client (type: Desktop app) and turn on 'Use this client for an AI-powered agent':
conn_google_step4: If you chose the Web application type, add this authorized redirect URI:
conn_google_step5: Paste the client ID and secret below and save; then 'Connect with Google'.
conn_google_preview: The models use Google's regular APIs (the built-in 'google' tool) right away. Google's official MCP servers are in Developer Preview: they only work after your Google Cloud project is accepted into the program (not a permission/scope problem).
conn_ms_desc: MCP for Outlook mail and calendar, OneDrive, Excel, OneNote, To Do (Teams and SharePoint with a work account); signs in with Microsoft's device code.
conn_ms_org_desc: Turn on for Teams, SharePoint and organization features; your organization may need to approve the app.
conn_ms_preparing: Preparing (the package downloads the first time)…
conn_node_missing: Node.js is needed: winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS
conn_ms_code: Enter this code on the Microsoft page that opened and approve with your account:
conn_ms_tools: Mail, calendar, OneDrive and Office tools are available to the models.
conn_google_step_testers: While the app is in 'Testing' only test users can sign in: on the Audience page add your own Google address with 'Add users' (otherwise you get 'Access blocked / 403 access_denied').
conn_google_apis: For the tools to work, each chosen service's API and MCP API must be enabled in your Google Cloud project (otherwise calls fail with 'API has not been used in project … or it is disabled'). The button opens them all on one page; wait a few minutes after enabling.
conn_google_apis_off: These services' APIs are off in your Google Cloud project: {names}. The button enables them on one page; wait a few minutes, then press 'Check again'.
conn_google_ready: The chosen services' APIs are on; the models can work in your Google account.
mcp_is_skills: This is a skills install command, not an MCP server: it copies SKILL.md instructions (from a GitHub repository, the Hugging Face marketplace or a Gradio Space). In the app they are imported as Skills.
repo_skills_note: Pick the skills you want. Each skill adds a short line to the model's prompt (~40 tokens): pick only the ones you will use. Files next to a skill (references, scripts) are added as links the model reads when needed.
repo_skills_too_many: At most 60 skills at once: every skill is added to the model's prompt.
